title.en: Testimonies from Both Banks of the Blackwater

desc.zh: 扣货点、渔场与边防争议各自指向不同的当事者。先查明实际所有者，再让对岸与担保人分别作答；每一份证词记在自己名下，谁也不能代签。
desc.en: The seizure point, the fishery and the border posts each point to a different party. Identify the actual owners first, then let the far bank and the distant guarantor answer for themselves; every testimony is kept under its own name and nobody signs for another.

title.en: The Ledger of River Defense and Border Trade

desc.zh: 河巡、仓储、征用与登记都要从当年账目里出：能付则全担，付不起则缩减，征粮必补或限缩，记账不赊欠。小国不必造远洋舰队，边民作证各有册可循。
desc.en: Patrols, granaries, requisitions and registrations are paid from the year's accounts: those who can pay carry the full share, those who cannot trim it, winter grain is either compensated or narrowed, and nothing is borrowed against the future. Small countries raise no ocean fleets, and the river folk keep their own registers.

title.en: The Agreement After the Spring Flood

desc.zh: 履约的冲突要经复议再定：新官认哪些旧票、弱小一方留什么退路、先开哪一处边市，都写进同一份河道通告；开河时逐船核账，守约留名，失约记败。
desc.en: Conflicts of fulfillment go through review before they stand: which old tickets the new officers honor, what way out the weaker side keeps, which single border market opens first, all written into one joint river notice. When the river opens, each boat is audited against the ledger; those who keep faith keep their name, defaults are recorded as they are.

desc.zh: 同一条船上扣下的货，河岸两边各亮出一张关票。提案国逐项核对：扣货点归哪个口岸、哪张票仍有资格生效、货主究竟是谁；答案入册，不先罚没。
desc.en: The cargo seized from one boat comes with a customs ticket from each bank. The proposing court verifies item by item: which port owns the seizure point, which ticket still qualifies, who the actual cargo owner is. The answers go on record; nothing is confiscated first.

title.en: The Fishery Missing from the War Map

desc.zh: 军图上没有的渔场，却是两岸几代人的口粮。保渔场习惯权则补给让步、地方认可上升；优先军需则哨所得手、渔课受损。定案后对岸与担保人分别作答。
desc.en: The fishery absent from the war chart feeds two banks of families. Keeping its customary right costs the supply column and wins local standing; putting the army first gains the watchpost and taxes the fishery. Once settled, the far bank and the distant guarantor each answer on their own.

title.en: The Boundary Marker on the Far Bank

desc.zh: 对岸国家自行答复：同意测界并共议边市，或只认边市不测界，或仍以旧界为准。界碑照旧立在原地，测不测、认不认，都记在对岸自己的册子上。
desc.en: The country on the far bank answers for itself: agree to survey the boundary together with a border market, accept the market but not the survey, or keep the old line. The marker stays where it stands; agreeing or refusing is entered in the far bank's own register.

title.en: Who Testifies for the River Folk

title.en: The First Boats of the Opening

desc.zh: 开河的日子到了，第一批船过市。通告上的承诺逐条受验：巡船在、仓廪实、边市开，则守约留名；有一项落空，就如实记败。核账回写各方国别册。
desc.en: When the river opens, the first boats pass the market. Each promise on the notice is checked: patrols standing, granaries full, the market open, and those who kept faith keep their name; one clause fallen through and the failure is recorded as it is. The verdict is written back to every participant's own register.
